decisions.reason: Although it is no longer separately visible on the website, this modular extension line rests directly on our waste-to-energy, automation and engineering knowledge, so we are more likely to absorb lessons and integrate or refine it than to withdraw it outright.

As a flagship application squarely within our core conversion and plant-engineering capabilities, the waste-oil-to-energy plant still fits our absorptive capacity strongly and is more likely to be improved than dropped.

Plastic-waste-to-fuel remains technically and commercially uncertain, but it is close enough to our established knowledge base and supported by our own R&D and research links that continued development is still slightly more likely than exit.
